rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page text layer) names the item. Text cells and combs: caption left of or above the cell, or the column header. Amounts: the 12/11-slot peso comb with the 2-slot centavo comb directly right form one money_joins pair. Boxes: X in the box immediately left of the printed option. Keys whose names carry no printed identity (j_id radios), seller/buyer TIN keys split across several cells, shared Schedule 4 A cells, and the Part III, signature and tax-agent blocks have no safe join and stay blank.
